name: Jørgen Ljønes
headline: Head of Finance and Governance Operations at 80,000 Hours
bio: Jørgen is Head of Finance and Governance Operations at 80,000 Hours. He previously managed Gi Effektivt and served as Assistant Executive Director at EA Norway. He also co-founded EA NTNU. He holds a master's degree in industrial economics and technology management from NTNU, with a computer science specialisation in AI and operations research.
